method: Frames = clip length x frame rate, rounded to the nearest whole frame. Single-machine time = frames x seconds per frame. The wall clock divides that by the number of machines and then adds the safety margin as a percentage of the divided time. Footage per hour = clip length / (wall clock / 3600). The clip length accepts plain seconds, mm:ss or h:mm:ss. The estimate assumes a constant cost per frame, no upload, transfer or scene-loading time, and linear scaling across machines; real render farms rarely scale perfectly, so the margin covers scheduling risk. Frame rate is used exactly as entered, so 23.976 and 29.97 are not rounded to 24 or 30.
